message.text: Searching proto/api/v1 for gRPC/Connect service definitions.

Eight gRPC/Connect services are defined under proto/api/v1. The names identified so far are AIService, AttachmentService, AuthService, IdentityProviderService, and InstanceService. The remaining names are still being determined.

The remaining three services are MemoService, ShortcutService, and UserService.

q05.
8: AIService, AttachmentService, AuthService, IdentityProviderService, InstanceService, MemoService, ShortcutService, UserService

Each is a `service` in `proto/api/v1/*_service.proto` (`ai`, `attachment`, `auth`, `idp`, `instance`, `memo`, `shortcut`, `user`). `proto/api/v1/common.proto` defines no service.
